_note: Per-query-averaged precision-recall for the test queries. Each query contributes one average precision (AP) and one interpolated PR curve, weighted equally regardless of family/clan size or query length, using each method's own hit order (no cross-query score comparison needed). This avoids the length bias of a pooled curve, important because RNA query lengths span two orders of magnitude. 'aupr' is the mean AP over queries; 'precision' is the mean interpolated PR curve on the 'recall' grid. Family: TP=same Rfam family, neutral=same clan/different family. Clan: TP=same clan/different family, neutral=same family. Unretrieved relevant targets remain false negatives.
